title: Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Turkish dish made with lamb, spices, and herbs, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless and cut into 1-inch cubes
Wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, chili flakes, garlic, parsley, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
4. Thread the lamb cubes onto the wooden skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with some oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Remove the kebabs from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
